name: Morgana
source: An ancient Tree Spirit, and the current ruler of the Fey Council, a position which she intends to take full advantage of in her constant quest for power. Ruthless, and incredibly powerful, she is a very dangerous person to make an enemy of. But what exactly are her plans for the MC?
